result.reason: The amendment appropriately adds up to six months of transition assistance at then-current rates and certified deletion, while leaving unrelated termination rights intact. However, the data-return deadline runs from Sparkling’s request rather than expiry or termination, so Garman is not unconditionally required to export the data within 30 days after the agreement ends. “Thereafter” also leaves the deletion and certification deadline indefinite. The operative language therefore does not fully reach the preferred position, despite the margin comment stating that it does.
